devices.name: Epanodos
devices.definition: Repetition of the chief words of a sentence in inverse order, to expound them.

occurrences.note: a Follow not that which is evil, b but that which is good. b He that doeth good is of God; a But he that doeth evil hath not seen God. For further illustration see under Correspondence. Antimetabole

devices.name: Antimetabole
devices.definition: Words repeated in reverse order and grammatical relation (“sabbath for man … man for sabbath”).
